items.title: Write Markdown Once, Publish It Everywhere: dev.to, Medium, AWS Builder Center and LinkedIn
items.summary: Markdown is easy to write and hard to publish. Every destination renders it differently, two have no API, and the failures show up only after you hit Publish. A step by step walk-through of publishing-kit, an agent skill that builds, checks and posts each version, used here to publish this article.
